description: Every part of the Work In Progress table is the pale blue-grey rather than white — the column headings, every data row and the Totals row all read as the same off-white tint. The table is meant to be all white.
steps: Open Reports, then Work In Progress, in light mode at 1680 x 1050, with both locations, Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and Staging Lethbridge - 4310 selected, on the Approved - Partially Completed tab.
Read the background colour of the heading row, a data row and the Totals row.
Do the same on the Estimates tab.
current:
The heading row, the data rows and the Totals row all read rgb(249, 250, 251) rather than white.

There is at least no alternating row shading, which is the other half of the requirement, and the Totals row is bold. Every figure in the table is correct.
expected: White column headings and white data cells, with no alternating row shading.
source: Each tab uses an all-white table: white column headers and white data cells, with no alternating row shading.
